entries.what: Linh took Anatomy at 9 a.m. with Dr. Okoye and sat next to Rochelle, who mentioned Andre's new 10-hour days starting this morning. Afterward she emailed Denny Wu's office and booked the transfer-planning meeting.
entries.outcome: Meeting with Denny booked for Oct 29 at 2 p.m.

entries.what: Worked Heron & Grind Monday shift, now the 3-9 closing shift, logging milk waste and locking the vault-room outlets. Wes was gone by then, so no cortado.
entries.outcome: First week of closing routine went smoothly

entries.what: Got home after 9, ate the plate Hạnh left, and updated her paper planner for the week.
entries.outcome: Week planned in washi tape

entries.what: Kenji drove her to campus for General Chemistry at 11 a.m. and she used the gap before class to review the 600-card anatomy deck.
entries.outcome: Got through the deck twice

entries.what: Went to Pedro's Tuesday 4 p.m. anatomy group at the library, where he quizzed everyone with 3D-printed bones. She noticed she kept getting flustered when he looked her way.
entries.outcome: Realized she has a crush on Pedro and told no one

entries.what: Studied at home with her dad's old radio on the desk, then went to bed around 12:30.
entries.outcome: Finished the muscles section in pink

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m., then worked the closing shift at Heron & Grind where Jun talked about Lola's Roll between orders.
entries.outcome: Helped Jun with a quick price check

entries.what: Heard from a customer that the council candidate forum at the community center was packing the room, which made the evening cafe crowd thinner than usual.
entries.outcome: Slow evening let her review flashcards

entries.what: Closed up, wrote milk waste on the clipboard, and went home to a plate from Hạnh.
entries.outcome: In bed by 12:30

entries.what: Kenji gave her a ride to General Chemistry at 11 a.m., and she took color-coded notes.
entries.outcome: Notes done for the chapter

entries.what: Studied in the library afterward and skipped lunch until Kenji handed her half a sandwich.
entries.outcome: Ate something at 3 p.m.

entries.what: Evening at home reviewing the yellow list for the practical.
entries.outcome: Yellow list trimmed to 40 structures

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m. and a quiz review with Rochelle, who complained about online quizzes.
entries.outcome: Helped Rochelle log in to the portal

entries.what: Spent the afternoon comparing used e-bike listings and messaged a seller about a $640 one.
entries.outcome: Arranged to see the e-bike Saturday

entries.what: Evening at home with Hạnh, who asked about pharmacy and Linh changed the subject to dinner.
entries.outcome: The pharmacy talk postponed again

entries.what: Worked the Saturday 6:30-1 shift at Heron & Grind, with Sam taking the second register.
entries.outcome: Shift went fine, decent tips

entries.what: After work she bought the used e-bike for $640 and arranged to charge it behind the cafe counter.
entries.outcome: Savings drained, new goal of $1,500 set

entries.what: Rode the e-bike home along Calle Ortega for the first time and ate dinner with Hạnh.
entries.outcome: Got home in half the time

entries.what: Sunday 6:30-1 shift at Heron & Grind, then rode the e-bike to Lotus Nails to work the front desk 2-5.
entries.outcome: Covered both jobs

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk for a short stretch in the late afternoon fog.
entries.outcome: Cleared her head

entries.what: Planned the week in her planner and asked her assistant for a day-by-day countdown to the practical on Oct 17, color-tagged to match her notes.
entries.outcome: Countdown schedule made, pink, blue, green and yellow
